spans.s: Arjunasya vane vāsaḥ : m.: Name of the 17th parvan in the list of a hundred subparvans of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṁgraha

, 33, 70; alluded to as pārthasya vanavāsaḥ in the contents of the Ādiparvan 1. 2. 91; it comprises Adhyāyas 1. 205-210.
